name: icon
summary: Renders a closed set of scalable SVG icons with decorative or standalone image semantics.

agent.useWhen: An interface action, status, or navigation cue benefits from a familiar glyph. Use a package catalog name and small, medium, or large size; add a label only when the icon stands alone and conveys meaning.
agent.avoidWhen: Text alone is clearer, the icon is interactive, or a product illustration is required.

invariants: Icon names are a closed set loaded from the package icons.json resource; arbitrary SVG is never accepted.
Icons are decorative and hidden from assistive technology by default.
A standalone meaningful icon requires a nonblank text label and is exposed as role img with aria-label.
The fragment has exactly one [[attributes]] slot and one [[geometry]] slot; the target adapter supplies SVG attributes and checked catalog geometry.
Icons are noninteractive and never enter the tab order.
